title: Semantic Kernel (Python) In-Memory Vector Store filter evaluates injected code
summary: Semantic Kernel for Python before 1.39.4 evaluates vector-store filter expressions with eval() behind a bypassable blocklist. An agent using the In-Memory Vector Store through the search plugin, and reachable by prompt injection, can be driven to execute code on the host. Deployments that do not use the In-Memory Vector Store are not affected.
